edit.statement: The two relations are disjoint on every person–account pair.
edit.subject: ownsAccount | isAuthorizedSignerOn
edit.original: Overlap on a person–account pair is permitted.
edit.scope: The same person can ordinarily own and be an authorized signer on the same account.

notes: Locality `expected` is the panel's logical reference; the scoring gold is the model's own pre-edit answer. Instance names are constructed fixtures given in each prompt. Chinese yes/no matching must treat the interrogative 是否 as one unit, so it never counts as 是 or 否.
